note: Real Dell capture, record 874245, redacted, nothing else changed: rundll32.exe as SYSTEM to a Microsoft address on 443, outside the ranges the rule filters. Upstream has two more filters, one on ParentImage with port 443 and one on CommandLine. Sysmon event 3 carries neither field, so the rule cannot use them. The event 1 one record earlier (874244) shows the PcaSvc.dll PcaPatchSdbTask started by svchost.exe, so upstream would have dropped this event and the port alerts on it.
